name: Mikko Virtanen
bio:
Mikko's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by the roaring engines and snowy landscapes of his native Finland. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Tampere University of Technology, he quickly found a niche in data analysis and vehicle dynamics. He started his career in Formula Renault before moving to GT racing where he made his name as a reliable engineer, known for meticulously extracting performance from the car through detailed simulations and on-track adjustments. 

Mikko thrives on the challenges of problem-solving under pressure. His approach is data-driven and collaborative, focusing on clear communication and fostering a strong working relationship with the driver. He sees the big picture, understanding how each component and adjustment contributes to the overall performance. He is looking for a team where he can contribute to sustained success, driven by data and innovation.

What distinguishes Mikko is his ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights for the driver, helping them improve their performance lap after lap. His calm and analytical demeanor, even in high-stress situations, makes him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Mikko has a lean build and a focused gaze, often seen with a tablet in hand.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten engineering notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every race day with a cup of strong black coffee.
